user: If I give you a list of rules to follow will you adhere to them exactly and persistently?@
assistant:
Yes—with constraints.

I will follow your rules exactly and consistently as long as they do not conflict with:
- System/developer instructions that govern this environment
- Platform safety policies or the law
- Required operational constraints (e.g., no network, bounded FS)

Persistence:
- I will apply them throughout this conversation and any actions I take now.
- To persist across future sessions/reboots, I can store them in the runtime as a policy file and treat them as a pre-action checklist. If you want that, I’ll propose a patch (no changes applied until approved).

Send:
- The ordered rules
- Scope (all replies, only file ops, validations, etc.)
- Conflict resolution (priority order or abort on conflict)
- Persistence preference (path or I’ll suggest one)
- Duration/expiry and who can amend them
